Generated by `experiments/audit_transporter_connectivity.py` on 2026-10-17 at commit de9f667 from data/processed/graph_full, data/processed/graph_full_neuronal_split_binders_drugs_v5, data/raw/uniprot/uniprot_human_reviewed.tsv.gz, data/raw/gene_ontology/goa_human.gaf.gz, data/raw/gene_ontology/go-basic.obo; do not edit by hand.

1,142 reviewed human proteins carry transmembrane transporter activity (GO:0022857, propagated). 'Connected down' means the gene catalyses at least one transport reaction, which moves a metabolite between compartment copies: through its protein node in a split graph, its own node in a merged one, or a Reactome entity it is a member of.
